Sam (Support): Escalating trial account 'PulseAI' — SSO completes but embed ingest returns 403. Renewal in 7 days, customer on a demo next week. :rotating_light:
Nia (CS): Ack. Paste repro and any logs here and I'll draft an urgent comms plan + owner contact.
Sam (Support): Repro below (seen on prod + staging):
```
GET /auth/okta/callback 302 -> /app
POST /embed/ingest 403 {"error":"forbidden", "detail":"tenant_not_mapped"}
```
Sam (Support): Account: pulseai-trial, region=us-east-2. Tried key rotate + cache flush, no change.
Arun (Eng): Looking — I see a tenant-mapper deploy ~40m ago. Pulling mapping logs now. :mag_right:
Lily (Solutions): Comms plan: (1) immediate ack + 20m ETA; (2) provide manual map workaround and KB link; (3) offer 30m enablement and a short feedback survey to capture renewal sentiment. I'll draft copy. KB: https://redwood.internal/kb/tenant-mapping#manual
Nia (CS): Good. Sam  who is the account owner and timezone? I'll schedule and message them.
Sam (Support): Owner is @tom.pulseai, MST. Sent a quick note; placeholder sync at 10:00 MST.
deploy-bot: deploy-start tenant-mapper-hotfix-174600 1746001360
Arun (Eng): Found the bug — tenant IDs with uppercase chars were normalized incorrectly. Hotfix built and testing (~10m).
deploy-bot: deploy-succeeded tenant-mapper-hotfix-174600 1746001435
Arun (Eng): Verified post-deploy: auth->embed flow succeeds for pulseai-trial in smoke tests. 403 cleared.
Nia (CS): I'll confirm with @tom.pulseai, remove the "at-risk" tag for now and schedule the enablement to capture feedback. Assigning follow-ups: Lily=invite + KB, Arun=postmortem + customer-friendly note, Nia=renewal review. :white_check_mark:
